まったく同じAppleのプライベートIDでログインしてるのに過去のCopilotアプリの会話履歴が出ないどころかユーザーについてのデータが何一つ参照されない。これでは元のCopilotがサ終で強制的にデータ削除されて別のAIアプリを入れられるのと同じ。名前だけ同じのパチモン。

追記:1時間以上経過すると突然過去アプリの会話ルームが出現し始めました。本来「同期中です」程度の案内はすべきだったのに、表示に一切なくさもデータの引き継ぎなどしていないように見えた。処理の不透明性が信頼を著しく損なっている。

2つ目は無限カルタで成功も失敗も関係なくライフが15も使われちゃうことです。私はたくさんXPをとって勝ち上がりたいのでライフが重要なんですだからせめて5がいいので改善お願いします。

つまりこの問題たちの解決策はかきんを安くするかルールをもっと緩和するですね。
5つ目は通知がうるさすぎる

長文すみませんでした。🙇最後まで読んでくれた人はありがとうございます😭😊解決お願いします🙇‍♀️🥺それ以外は神なので入れたほうがいいです。

習ってない単語で英文の質問が書かれ

習ってない単語だらけの英文を選択しろとなり

title: AUv3 transport sync needs improvement
body:
Great sampler, but AUv3 transport sync needs improvement.

I’m using DM10 4.6.1 as an AUv3 inside Koala 2.0.12. DM10 follows Koala’s tempo correctly, but its sequencer does not reset to the beginning when Koala is stopped and restarted. Each time I press Play, DM10 starts from a different step. The shorter the time between Stop and Play, the closer the starting position is.

I tested the same DM10 AUv3 in Cubasis and it works correctly, so this appears to be a Koala host transport-sync issue.

Please add/fix proper AUv3 transport position and Start/Stop synchronization so AUv3 sequencers reliably start from the correct position when Koala starts playback.

title: Too much tapping to advance to next lesson
body:
On the whole, I find Duolingo to be a helpful language learning tool. But after a short lesson, it takes up to 19 screen taps just to get to the next lesson, which is incredibly annoying and frustrating. They force you to do things like collect puzzle pieces or click multiple times on a meaningless treasure chest, which feels a lot like playing a slot-machine. They offer no opt-out, even for the paid tiers, which is a big miss. 

When Duo is not wasting my time on annoying casino-inspired “rewards”, the learning content itself is very useful. AI-assisted live conversations in the paid subscriptions have helped me become more confident in using my speaking skills. Their space repetition for learning new words is also quite effective.

title: Worse than I remember
body: I originally submitted another form a few months ago, praising the app. I've since realized I don't entirely enjoy the app anymore. One thing you must know is that I am currently taking high school Spanish (this is very important to know), and I think I learn better there than here. My reason for this is it doesn't do a good job explaining important concepts, such as Grammer. I had to learn Grammer in my Spanish class to get the questions surrounding it right. Another reason is that some of the words it's teaching are wrong. An example of this is teacher. The word for teacher in Spanish is "profesor (masc.)" or "profesora (fem.)". Duolingo presents that "maestro" is the word for "teacher", which is incorrect. I do understand that different countries have different words for different terms, but this should be an easy fix.

title: A few more features needed.
body:
Apple Journal is a really good journaling app. The design and overall aesthetic are clean, simple, and beautiful — I actually prefer it to Day One in that respect.

Where Day One is still better is discovery and reflection. Its journaling prompts are stronger, and “On This Day” is a fantastic feature that I’d love to see Apple add.

Apple could take that even further with AI: occasionally surface an old journal entry that relates to what I’m writing about now — a similar experience, thought, place, person, or theme from months or years ago. Even a simple randomized “From Your Journal” feature would be great.

The app already feels excellent to use. It just needs better ways to rediscover what you’ve written.

title: Unable to Watch games as advertised
body:
The NFL has created one of the most ridiculous and anti-consumer streaming systems I’ve ever dealt with.

I paid for NFL+ thinking I could watch an NFL game. Nope. Then you find out certain games are only available on certain devices. Other games depend on your local market. Then there’s FOX, CBS, ESPN, Prime Video, Peacock, Sunday Ticket, YouTube TV and a bunch of other services all connected through different broadcasting agreements and restrictions.

You can literally PAY for an NFL subscription and still be told you can’t watch the game you want on your TV.

Then you start another streaming trial because the game is supposedly on that network, enter your ZIP code, and find out the game still isn’t available in your area. Want an out-of-market Sunday game? Now you’re being pushed toward another expensive subscription.

This entire system is absurd.

A customer shouldn’t need a flowchart to watch football. I should be able to open an NFL app, select the game I want, pay a reasonable price if necessary, and watch it on whatever device I own.

Instead, the NFL has allowed its games to be fragmented across so many networks, subscriptions, regional restrictions, and device restrictions that figuring out WHERE you’re allowed to watch a game is harder than actually watching it.

I’m not complaining because I expect everything for free. I’m complaining because even after PAYING, the system can still tell you that you bought the wrong subscription, you’re on the wrong device, you’re in the wrong market, or you need yet another service.

Absolutely ridiculous system for one of the biggest sports leagues in the world.

title: Works great, found codes other hardware readers missed
body:
IF you have trouble connecting to a wifi OBD reader, keep denying it Bluetooth access. It defaults to Bluetooth and then connects to wifi as a last resort. It takes a minute...

Aside from that, the app is great. There are MULTIPLE on demand self-tests for different components that you can run from your phone. The selling point for me was having the injector test at my fingertips.

The app is THOROUGH when showing codes. When I bought my truck, I put a AutoZone code reader on it, and no codes showed up (no CEL either). Later, I did a scan with the app that showed multiple soft codes that never tripped the CEL or showed on other apps OR hardware code readers. 

The PID monitoring is a bit clunky... To be fair, I use a different app to monitor things like oil temp, coolant temp, trans temp, battery volts, etc etc, but it DOES do it.

All in all, a 5 star rating and definitely worth the costs.
